name: Twin on-chain re-arm — hashrate and active-address growth confirm a network-backed trend
rationale: On-chain conviction has two independent sides: SUPPLY-side (miners committing hashpower) and DEMAND-side (users actually transacting). A trend confirmed by BOTH is backed by the full network, not just one constituency. The thesis: when btc_hashrate crosses UP (miners re-arm — supply-side commitment) AND btc_active_addresses crosses UP (network usage/demand is growing) AND momentum is positive, go long spot — the move has structural support from both producers and users. Both are drifting on-chain series so each is read ONLY via cross_up/cross_down (never a raw level). Exit when usage rolls over (active_addresses cross_down) or miners capitulate. Disconfirmer (core falsifier): the edge must come specifically from the SUPPLY-side (miner) arm adding orthogonal info beyond demand-side usage. If dropping the btc_hashrate cross_up arm (keeping btc_active_addresses cross_up + ret_Nd>0) matches or beats deflated Sharpe, the hashrate arm is redundant and the demand-side usage signal carries it all. Low-confidence until OOS; the Gate decides.
catalyst: btc_hashrate AND btc_active_addresses both cross up (supply + demand on-chain confirmation) while momentum is positive
